fieldValues.title: G7 AI-assisted practice
fieldValues.summary: AI works inside a current Protocol or Blueprint context, proposes visibly with provenance, and never commits canonical meaning without human review and ratification.
fieldValues.body:
## Group Need

We want AI to propose useful wording and coaching from conversation evidence while people retain judgment and authority.

## Semantic Adds

- TSS and transcript provenance
- AI proposal provenance
- human review and ratification evidence

## Blueprint Adds

- stage-specific AI proposal review
- inspectable source-provenance facet

## Does Not Introduce

- AI authority
- an AI-specific editor
- a separate canonical store

## Activation Trigger

A group has a reliable manual Protocol practice and wants assistive coaching or transcript-grounded drafting.
